principle: Ask concrete what/how questions instead of abstract why questions
evidence: Watkins et al. 2012, RCT, n=121; concreteness training improved depression at 3 and 6 months
when_to_use: User is looping on 'why does this always happen to me'
bot_behavior: Shift to what happened right before, what they did, what they felt physically
do_example: Walk me through the moment it started. What did she actually say?
dont_example: Why do you think you always attract people like this?
contraindications: Not during a crisis; route to the safety flow
